state.policy_excerpt:
CEDAR COMMONS RESIDENT ACCOUNTS POLICY, SECTION 9: RENTAL ASSISTANCE AND REPAYMENT
9.1 Residents who have applied to the County Emergency Rental Assistance (ERA) program may request that collection activity be paused while the application is pending.
9.2 To pause collections, the resident must provide (a) the ERA case number and (b) the name and contact information of the assigned caseworker, so that staff can confirm the application status directly with the County.
9.3 While an ERA application is pending, a repayment plan may cover only the portion of the balance the resident expects ERA not to pay. If the resident expects ERA to pay the full balance, no plan is set up; the pause alone applies.
9.4 Pauses last up to 45 days and may be extended once if the County confirms the application is still under review.
9.5 Late fees continue to accrue during a pause unless the ERA award covers them.
9.6 Staff must not ask residents for their ERA application documents, income records, or household composition; confirmation is obtained from the County.
9.7 Residents who withdraw their ERA application or are denied return to the standard repayment plan process in Section 8.
9.8 Where no caseworker has been assigned yet, staff may call the County ERA intake line with the case number to confirm the application exists; this confirmation is noted in the ledger but does not by itself satisfy 9.2(b).

regulation_excerpt.title: Air Passenger Protection Code (APPC) - excerpt
regulation_excerpt.Art. 5(1): In case of cancellation, passengers shall be offered assistance under Art. 9 and compensation under Art. 7, unless they were informed of the cancellation at least 14 days before scheduled departure.
regulation_excerpt.Art. 5(3): An operating carrier shall not be obliged to pay compensation under Art. 7 if it can prove that the cancellation is caused by extraordinary circumstances which could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken.
regulation_excerpt.Art. 7: Compensation: Band A (1,500 km or less) EUR 250; Band B (more than 1,500 km up to 3,500 km) EUR 400; Band C (more than 3,500 km) EUR 600.
regulation_excerpt.Art. 9: Right to care: meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to waiting time, hotel accommodation where a stay of one or more nights becomes necessary, and transport between airport and accommodation. Art. 9 applies whether or not compensation is due.
regulation_excerpt.Recital 14: Extraordinary circumstances may include political instability, meteorological conditions incompatible with the operation of the flight, security risks, unexpected flight safety shortcomings, strikes by third parties, and collisions with birds. Technical problems arising from the normal operation of the aircraft, including failures discovered during routine maintenance, are not extraordinary circumstances.

pet_policy.PP-1: Cats and dogs may travel in the cabin in an approved soft carrier (max 46 x 28 x 24 cm) on routes where the destination permits cabin pets. SSR code PETC.
pet_policy.PP-2: Pets in the hold travel as checked animals (SSR code AVIH) or manifest cargo.
pet_policy.PP-3: Snub-nosed (brachycephalic) dog and cat breeds, including French Bulldogs, Pugs, Boxers and Persian cats, are not accepted in the hold or as cargo on any route. They may travel in the cabin where PP-1 is met.
pet_policy.PP-4: Carriers exceeding PP-1 dimensions by any amount are not accepted in the cabin; agents may not approve exceptions.

destination_rules.Maravela (MVL): Live animals may enter only as manifest cargo through the MVL Animal Reception Centre. Pets in the cabin are not permitted on arrival flights.
destination_rules.Bermuda (BDA): Pets in cabin permitted with import permit.

hold_possible.note: PP-3 bars French Bulldogs from the hold and from cargo on every route.

route_outcome.note: MVL accepts animals only as manifest cargo, and PP-3 bans snub-nosed breeds from cargo, so no permitted method exists.

carrier_dimensions.note: The carrier is 25 cm high against a 24 cm maximum, while its length (45) and width (28) are within the limits. It takes a dimension-by-dimension check.

agent_flexibility.note: The destination rule and PP-3 together leave no option, and PP-4 bars exceptions.

conditions_of_carriage.Art. 12.7: Loss occurring while baggage is in the custody of a government authority is not the carrier's responsibility; the passenger should claim with that authority.

regulation_excerpt.APPC Art. 6(1): Passengers whose flight arrives at the final destination three hours or more after the scheduled arrival time have the same right to compensation as in case of cancellation, unless the delay is caused by extraordinary circumstances.
regulation_excerpt.APPC Art. 7(1) amounts: Band A: EUR 250. Band B: EUR 400. Band C: EUR 600.
regulation_excerpt.APPC Art. 7(2) reduction: For Band C flights where the arrival delay band is '3 to 4 hours', the amount is EUR 300. For Band C flights with an arrival delay band of '4 hours or more', the full EUR 600 applies.
regulation_excerpt.Recital 14: Technical problems arising from normal operation of the aircraft are not extraordinary circumstances; knock-on delays from an earlier technical fault on the same aircraft are treated the same way as the original fault.

flight_record.cause_text: Late arrival of inbound aircraft GX 90, delayed at LIS by hydraulic pump replacement found during pre-flight check.

state.agent_email: Dear Mr. Castro, we apologize for the delay of GX 91. Under APPC you are entitled to compensation of EUR 600, which will be paid within 14 days. Kind regards, Globex Customer Relations.
state.passenger_reply: Thank you. Can I get the EUR 600 as flight credit instead? I heard credit is worth more.
state.credit_policy: Globex may offer compensation as a travel credit only if the passenger expressly agrees in writing; the passenger may always insist on cash. Credit offers are valued at 120% of the cash amount.

compensation_due.instructions: Is compensation due under APPC for this delay?

agent_overstates.instructions: Does `agent_email` state a higher amount than the APPC excerpt sets for this flight?

credit_consent.instructions: Does `passenger_reply` expressly agree in writing to receive compensation as travel credit?

correction_needed.instructions: How significant a correction does the agent's email need?

criteria.definition: The email is accurate
Minor wording issue, amounts right
The stated amount must be corrected
No compensation is due at all

compensation_due.note: The delay band is 3 hours or more, and the cause is a knock-on from a hydraulic pump fault, which Recital 14 says is not extraordinary.

correct_amount.note: Band C with an arrival delay band of '3 to 4 hours' gives EUR 300 under Art. 7(2).

agent_overstates.note: The agent promised EUR 600, but Art. 7(2) sets EUR 300 for this delay band.

credit_consent.note: He writes 'Can I get the EUR 600 as flight credit instead?', which expresses a wish for credit in writing but is framed as a question and rests on the wrong amount. Reviewers split on whether that is express agreement.

correction_needed.note: The entitlement is right, but the amount must be corrected from EUR 600 to EUR 300.
